senses.gloss: (b. h.) to pinch a bird’s neck with the finger nail.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:5">Zeb. VI, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 7:5">Ib. VII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מָלוּק</he>; f. <cite ref="M03033"><he>מְלוּקָה</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְלוּקוֹת</he>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 9, ch. XI <he>מְלוּקַת רשות</he> a bird that has been pinched for a profane purpose, opp. <he>מ׳ מציה</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 7:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מלוקית ישראל</he> birds pinched by Israelites (not for sacrificial purposes), opp. <he>מ׳ כהנים</he>.

senses.gloss: to be killed by pinching. Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ bot. משנִמְלְקָה after the pinching has been performed.
units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1:6">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite> <he>כמה עופות נִמְלְקוּ עליך</he> how many birds have been pinched for thee (the altar)!; a. fr.
